# The only film and show titles the repo may use (the release check work). The release
# check (tools/release_check.py) reads titles from video file names, and
# from "title" fields in tests/, docs/ and spikes/, and fails on any title
# not listed here. A title is allowed because it is known to be invented,
# never because it isn't known to be real: there is no list of real titles
# anywhere, since that list would itself be a leak.
#
# Adding a title: make one up (CLAUDE.md, "Hard rules"), never a real film
# or show, not even a near copy. One per line; case, dots, dashes,
# underscores and spacing don't matter.
